items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I got the Salt City Six together in '71 to go in there with me

ctx.x: You had to do all your own booking then too or were you working some in agencies and some---

Well, some and I had places I went steady like Cleveland - maybe I did Cleveland two times a year; each time I went I took a different band; once I went with an organized band thinking that's the way to go. I got the Salt City Six together in '71 to go in there with me and it was a very successful deal because their band-- I wasn't responsible for their withholdings because I actually put myself with them.
Yeah, Jack Mayhew and Will Alger.
